test_ufuncs_single: test numpy ufuncs like np.abs and np.sign on FloatingArray and Series
test_ufuncs_single_float: test numpy ufuncs like np.log, np.exp, np.sin, np.cos, np.sqrt on FloatingArray

test_value_counts: test value_counts on Float64 Series with dropna and normalize options
